feature_intent: count-only WiFi/BLE scan richness by evening and late windows
hashed-never-persisted proximity signature repeat rate within subject/day
near-device burst density from RSSI thresholds, without storing raw network identifier values
source_blueprint.target_hypothesis: S3/Q3 may react to social/place density and late-day context shifts rather than raw GPS paths.

feature_intent: speech/conversation/crowd scores as social context indicators
inside/outside and vehicle/music scores as coarse environment states
late-evening ambience volatility instead of daily aggregate ambience totals
source_blueprint.target_hypothesis: S3 and Q3 can plausibly depend on social stimulation and environment recovery pressure.

feature_intent: 10-minute-bin co-occurrence of proximity scans with speech/crowd ambience
screen-on persistence when proximity/social ambience is active
subject-relative novelty of proximity+ambience state sequences
source_blueprint.target_hypothesis: This is materially different from closed GPS topology, usage Markov, and ambience-only lanes.

material_difference.vs_gps_path_topology: Uses no coordinate/path topology; proximity IDs are only ephemeral count/signature inputs.
material_difference.vs_usage_semantic_burst_markov: Uses WiFi/BLE/social ambience co-occurrence, not app-category Markov chains.
material_difference.vs_phase3_ambience_context: Requires cross-sensor proximity+ambience timing, not ambience-only daily context.
material_difference.vs_event_cadence_or_dropout: Uses context co-occurrence intensity, not missingness or generic event cadence alone.

privacy_and_leakage_guards: Do not persist raw WiFi/BLE identifiers or exact proximity token values in reports or feature matrices.
Use predeclared ambience groups and RSSI thresholds; no target-guided vocabulary selection.
Any later model smoke must fit preprocessing fold-internally and may only report split losses.
No submission artifact, base prediction artifact, notebook/history artifact, or submission-log row is authorized.

decision.next_action: Run only the report-only metadata/co-occurrence smoke next; do not write a feature matrix, train, create ID342, run Kaggle, or submit.
